title: Zonoid context compression direction
summary: Feasibility assessment: zonoid should not blindly proxy all agent traffic through Headroom-style generic compression because zonoid already has structured graph retrieval, abstain-by-default search gating, 2k task summaries, 200-char result snippets, local embeddings/rerank, and usage accounting. The better direction is a native compressed-view layer at zonoid's MCP/read boundaries: typed reducers for large graph/search/task/tool outputs, preserve stable ids and retrieval handles, and allow exact detail fetch via existing get_task_detail/search_knowledge paths. Headroom can still be tested externally as an opt-in wrapper for Codex/Claude, but integration risk is losing provenance/reversibility semantics unless zonoid owns the compression metadata.
